She also inadvertently explains hippies and how we got where we are. If anyone is interested, I'll expand.

But here's why I bring this up: Didion explains in detail how much those in newly formed Los Angeles/Hollywood detested people from New York. A whole anti-east-coast movement sprung up and was the impetus for the way a lot of things were done on the West Coast. In many ways they created their culture as Anti-New York. Sort of the way Americans in the new world wanted to set themselves apart from Britain, so they took the "u" out of words like colour and favour. They wanted to show in everyday activities they were different, so they switched hands with the fork instead of stabbing food with the fork in the right hand. Like that.

I spoke with a liberal from commiefornia last week who informed me that "everyone in California knows what a shithead Donald Trump is. He's SO NEW YORK. We never liked him, even though he was a Reality TV star and supported the Democrats in some elections." That triggered a little research into Didion's book. THIS IS SUCH A CALIFORNIA THING TO SAY. Doesn't matter what someone does, they are a traitor if they are from New Yawk. These people even threw one of their own under the bus (Weinstein - a New Yorker) when he was no longer useful.

OK OK - here's the TL;DR: I wonder if there is a bit of strategy for 2020 in this move for POTUS. This isn't just taxes or they're beating him up. This could be signaling to Left Coasters that he's not "one of them" - meaning one of "Those New Yorkers" anymore. He even had Cuomo saying that Donald Trump is Not A New Yorker! And New Yorkers might think that 's a bad thing, but the rest of the country is kinda OK with that.
